REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

  Service: CloudMonitor

  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/essentials/data-platform-metrics, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/overview/azure/monitor-querymetrics-readme

Option 6 — Amazon CloudWatch Metrics:

  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: get_metric_data, get_metric_statistics, list_metrics
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_GetMetricData.html, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_ListMetrics.html

```python
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Configuration
API_KEY = 'YOUR_DATADOG_API_KEY'
APP_KEY = 'YOUR_DATADOG_APP_KEY'
BASE_URL = 'https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1'

def get_recent_datapoints(metric_name, start_time, end_time):
    """
    Query recent datapoints for a named metric over a time window using Datadog API.

    Args:
        metric_name (str): The name of the metric to query.
        start_time (datetime): The start time of the time window.
        end_time (datetime): The end time of the time window.

    Returns:
        list: A list of datapoints containing timestamp and value.
    """
    # Convert datetime objects to Unix timestamps in seconds
    start_timestamp = int(start_time.timestamp())
    end_timestamp = int(end_time.timestamp())

    # Prepare the query parameters
    params = {
        'q': f'metric:{metric_name}',
        'from': start_timestamp,
        'to': end_timestamp,
        'fn': 'last',
        'type': 'timeserie',
        'fn': 'rollup',
        'rollup': 'sum',
        'aggregation_key': 'custom_metric_rollup',
        'format': 'json'
    }

    # Set headers with Datadog API key
    headers = {
        'DD-API-KEY': API_KEY,
        'DD-APPLICATION-KEY': APP_KEY
    }

    # Make the API request
    response = requests.get(BASE_URL + '/query', params=params, headers=headers)

    # Check for successful response
    if response.status_code == 200:
        data = response.json()
        if 'series' in data and len(data['series']) > 0:
            datapoints = []
            for series in data['series']:
                for datapoint in series['datapapoints']:
                    timestamp = datetime.fromtimestamp(datapoint[0])
                    value = datapoint[1]
                    datapoints.append({'timestamp': timestamp, 'value': value})
            return datapoints
        else:
            raise ValueError("No data returned from Datadog API")
    else:
        raise Exception(f"Error fetching data from Datadog API: {response.status_code} - {response.text}")

# Example usage
# recent_datapoints = get_recent_datapoints('my.metric', datetime.now() - timedelta(days=1), datetime.now())
#
